title: Akbar
summary: Akbar, third Mughal emperor, was born in 1542 in Sind and proclaimed emperor in 1556, taking personal control of the empire in 1562. He captured Chitor in 1568 and defeated Gujarat in 1573, and for years held court at the new palace-city of Fatehpur Sikri. Encyclopedia.com notes his marriages with Rajput princesses are read both as toleration and as signs of Rajput submission.

as_recorded.value: He was born on October 15, 1542, in Umarkot, Sind

importance.justification: EBSCO describes him as bringing much of India and parts of Afghanistan under Mughal control, with administrative reforms and a policy of religious tolerance.

reviewer_note: Pin is the birthplace Umarkot (Encyclopedia.com; EBSCO says only the kingdom of Sind), not the seat of his rule. Encyclopedia.com has two entries on one page: one gives accession in 1556, the other says he was crowned at fourteen; EBSCO says thirteen. The summary uses the year only. No Hamzanama link: that outline was skipped. EBSCO also reports the 1568 Chitor massacre of thirty thousand prisoners; it is omitted from the summary.
